2609.19985.title: Past, Future, All at Once: Mitigating Stability-Plasticity Dilemma via Post-hoc JANUS Rectification
2609.19985.paper_summary: Fine-tuning foundation models on new tasks inevitably suffer from catastrophic forgetting. While existing works attempt to mitigate this on the basis of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, they adopted an overly restrictive Subspace Orthogonality condition. In this paper, we introduce a purely post-hoc and tuning-agnostic weight rectification framework that achieves Parameter Space Orthogonality, which is the necessary and sufficient condition for preserving historical performance to the first order. By projecting parameter updates into the JAcobian NUll Space (JANUS), our method significantly recovers compromised historical knowledge without interfering with the underlying fine-tuning process. To overcome the local validity of the Jacobian approximation, we further propose a Multi-step Adaptive Rectification mechanism that utilizes the JANUS shift to dynamically verify the valid trust region and adjust step sizes. Coupled with our proposed ghost projection, ghost orientation comparison, and sequence-level singular value decomposition compression techniques, JANUS also achieves great temporal and spatial efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that JANUS seamlessly integrates with various fine-tuning methods, significantly mitigating the stability-plasticity dilemma by recovering historical knowledge while preserving downstream task adaptation.
2609.19985.paper_summary_zh: 微調基礎模型在新任務上不可避免地會遭遇災難性遺忘。雖然現有的研究嘗試基於參數高效的微調方法來減輕這一問題，但它們採用了過於嚴格的子空間正交性條件。在本文中，我們引入了一種純粹的事後和無關調整的權重矯正框架，實現了參數空間正交性，這是保留歷史性能的一階必要且充分條件。通過將參數更新投影到雅可比零空間（JANUS），我們的方法顯著恢復了妥協的歷史知識，而不干擾底層的微調過程。為了克服雅可比近似的局部有效性，我們進一步提出了一種多步自適應矯正機制，利用JANUS位移動態驗證有效的信任區域並調整步長。結合我們提出的幽靈投影、幽靈方向比較和序列級奇異值分解壓縮技術，JANUS還實現了出色的時間和空間效率。實驗表明，JANUS與各種微調方法無縫集成，顯著減輕了穩定性-可塑性困境，通過恢復歷史知識同時保留下游任務的適應性。
